# UniHunt

> UniHunt helps students and working professionals study and build careers abroad.
> Focus: Dubai (UAE) first, with selected programmes in the UK and Germany.
> UniHunt is a standalone venture supported by UniMarg Higher Education Consultancy.

## What UniHunt does
- Study Abroad: university and course selection, applications, SOP/LOR support,
  scholarships guidance, visa and pre-departure support (UK, Germany, UAE).
- Careers Abroad: professional licensing and job placement, with a primary focus
  on healthcare roles in Dubai (nurses, doctors, dentists, pharmacists):
  DHA/HAAD/MOH licensing, exam preparation, Dataflow and document processing,
  interview support, placement, and visa/travel assistance.

## Key facts
- Destinations: United Arab Emirates (primary), United Kingdom, Germany.
- Audience: students (undergraduate and postgraduate) and working professionals.
- Engagement model: end-to-end guidance from first enquiry to arrival abroad.
